description: This Java source file defines an abstract class IteratorWrapper that implements custom iteration logic by wrapping an existing iterator. The class provides mechanisms for transforming, filtering, and managing elements during iteration, intended for subclassing to specify conversion and removal behaviors.

classes.name: IteratorWrapper
classes.description: An abstract class that wraps an iterator to provide custom element conversion, validation, and removal behaviors during iteration.

methods.name: hasNext
methods.description: Checks if the wrapped iterator has more elements, performing validation and conversion as necessary.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the iteration, converting it if needed.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the last element returned by the iterator from the underlying collection.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Determines whether the current source element and its converted destination are valid for iteration; can be overridden.

methods.name: noteRemoval
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for handling removal logic of elements.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented for converting source elements to destination elements.
